层次与深度
Glass
深度通过玻璃、边框对比以及可复用的阴影或模糊处理来传达。请在主视觉面板、卡片与控件间保持这些配方一致，使页面读起来像同一套材质体系。
表面应优先呈现玻璃质感，边框、阴影与模糊仅用于强化这一材质选择。
技法
复制技法
渐变边框外壳
Use a thin gradient border shell around the main card. Wrap the surface in an outer shell with 0px padding and a 0px radius. Drive the shell with radial-gradient(circle at -4% 4%, rgba(0, 148, 255, 0.98) 0%, rgba(0, 154, 255, 0.82) 15%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 34%), radial-gradient(circle at 11% 12%, rgba(0, 45, 150, 0.95) 0%, rgba(0, 83, 200, 0.65) 10%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 25%), radial-gradient(circle at 32% 12%, rgba(159, 230, 255, 0.98) 0%, rgba(196, 241, 255, 0.82) 20%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 39%), radial-gradient(circle at 55% 10%, rgb(255, 239, 40) 0%, rgba(255, 226, 35, 0.95) 27%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 48%), radial-gradient(circle at 78% 12%, rgba(255, 175, 0, 0.98) 0%, rgba(255, 118, 24, 0.82) 24%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 45%), radial-gradient(circle at 104% 8%, rgba(255, 24, 90, 0.95) 0%, rgba(255, 72, 122, 0.78) 26%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 49%), radial-gradient(circle at 90% 47%, rgba(255, 137, 178, 0.7) 0%, rgba(255, 200, 210, 0.75) 29%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 54%), radial-gradient(circle at 47% 46%, rgba(255, 243, 118, 0.88) 0%, rgba(255, 251, 203, 0.78) 23%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 49%), radial-gradient(circle at 32% 75%, rgb(255, 251, 225) 0%, rgba(255, 248, 223, 0.82) 34%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 58%), linear-gradient(rgba(255, 252, 231, 0) 0%, rgba(255, 250, 237, 0.72) 63%, rgb(255, 255, 255) 100%) so the edge reads like premium depth instead of a flat stroke. Keep the actual stroke understated so the gradient shell remains the hero edge treatment. Inset the real content surface inside the wrapper with a slightly smaller radius so the gradient only appears as a hairline frame.

规范与禁忌
遵循这些约束，可让后续生成保持与当前体系一致，避免漂移到相邻风格。
建议
• 以主色盘作为强调与操作状态的主要点缀色。
• keep spacing aligned to the detected 12px rhythm.
• 在卡片与控件上统一复用玻璃表面处理。
• keep corner radii within the detected 12px, 9999px family.
避免
• 除非页面需要新的语义状态，否则不要引入核心色盘角色之外的额外点缀色。
• 不要混用无关的阴影或模糊配方，以免破坏当前深度体系。
• 不要exceed the detected moderate motion intensity without a deliberate reason.
动效
动效克制且以界面为主导，贯穿文字、布局与区块过渡。 时序主要聚集在 150ms 与 500ms。 缓动偏好 Cubic 0, 0, 0.2, 1 与 Cubic 0.4, 0, 0.2, 1。 悬停行为侧重 Text 与 颜色 变化。
